_comment: A connector is DATA, never code. It says how to read what is inside a folder, never WHERE that folder is - the human picks the folder. Paths use dots for object keys and [] to walk an array. Nothing here is evaluated.
_shellWrite_comment: Where the command string of a shell tool sits. The PATTERNS are not here and never will be: a connector is data a stranger can ship, so it says WHERE to look and the app decides HOW. Measured 2026-08-29: 98 of 211 sessions wrote files this way and no other.
_mark: DRAWN, not traced: no Anthropic asset ships on this machine to vectorise, so this is a rendering of the Claude burst from its published form - twelve tapered rays meeting at the centre. Tony authorised approximate marks on 2026-09-06 after the risk was named, and this field says plainly that it is an approximation. The day an official path exists it replaces this one, with no code change.
